text: Auto quality starts phones and tablets (coarse primary pointer) on the low tier and everything else on high.
Every shader in the loaded scene compiles behind the loading screen, so flying to new views by day and night links no new programs.

Auto quality measures frame time and steps pixel ratio, shadows and view distance down one rung when the 2 s median frame is over 28 ms and back up when it is under 18 ms, holding a rung it fell from for 30 s (doubling on repeats), never climbing above the starting tier and linking no new shaders; a chosen Low, Medium or High tier stays fixed.
With side activities off (the default) the beacon layer shows Founder Trail beacons only and its scan does no lock or position work for side activities; turning them on brings their beacons back.
